function.name: game_board_analyser
function.description: Analyse a given board position of the game and suggest the optimal next move Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

game.description: The name of the game. In this case, chess

player.description: The current player whose turn is to move.

position.description: The current state of the board in FEN (Forsyth–Edwards Notation) format.

message.content:
The most prominent event in 2015 was the **World Chess Championship**.  
In that match, played in September‑October 2015 in New Delhi, India, **Magnus Carlsen** successfully defended his title against Sergey Karjakin, winning 6½–4½ after 12 classical games plus rapid tiebreaks.

If you were thinking of another specific tournament (e.g., the Tata Steel Chess Tournament, the Candidates Tournament, etc.), let me know and I can give details on those winners as well!
